body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Lenovo unveiled the first laptop supporting two LCD screens, 'ThinkPad W700ds' at the pre-press event '2009 CES Unveiled'. It has a 17-inch primary and a 10.2-inch secondary LED screen.

Coming with the option of either Intel Core 2 Extreme or Core 2 Quad processor, the ThinkPad W700ds adopts a 8GB of RAM, 980GB HDD and Nvidia Quadro FX 3700M. It also offers about 2 hours of battery life
